subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — proposed slots & pre-call checklist
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@blueharbor.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — proposed slots & pre-call checklist

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can lock a sizing deep-dive (60 minutes) to scope dedicated capacity: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary workload: conversational customer support (multi-turn chat + retrieval)
- Expected steady-state: ~180–220 inference requests/sec
- 95th pct latency target: ~500–800ms (token-level SLO: p95 < 800ms)
- Peak burst: ~1.5x steady-state for short windows (90s)
- Data: no PHI, sensitive PII redaction handled upstream

What we want to cover on the sizing call:
- Exact throughput/latency targets per endpoint and sequence length profile
- Typical prompt + response token distribution (we'll use your sample traces)
- Failure/fallback policies and acceptable degradation behavior
- Autoscale/burst strategy and expected traffic patterns (weekday vs weekend)
- Runbook & handoff expectations for Dedicated pools

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT):
- Mon 3/27 09:30–10:30
- Tue 3/28 11:00–12:00
- Wed 3/29 15:00–16:00

Please pick one that works and confirm who from BlueHarbor will join (technical ops / infra lead ideal). I attached my quick discovery notes and a simple sizing-template we can pre-fill — if you can drop sample token histograms ahead of time that will make the call much faster.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf; sizing-template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Chen <alex@blueharbor.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:10:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — proposed slots & pre-call checklist

Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear recap. Tue 3/28 11:00–12:00 PT works best for our team. I will bring Maria Gates (infra lead) to the call — copying her below and forwarding the sizing-template.

Quick note: our expected average token lengths are shorter for customer prompts (~40–60 tokens) but responses average ~220 tokens; we'll add example traces before Tue. Also want to confirm whether Redwood needs sample KV cache patterns or just raw request traces — Maria can advise on that.

Alex Chen
Head of Product, BlueHarbor
alex@blueharbor.io | +1 (206) 555-0123

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@blueharbor.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — proposed slots & pre-call checklist

Alex — thanks, Tue 3/28 11:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Adding Ben from our infra team to help with runbook and kernel/quantization questions.

Maria — to answer your note: raw request traces are perfect (timestamp, request_id, prompt_tokens, response_tokens). If you can also include a short sample of session affinity / KV cache hit ratios (even estimated) that will let us size the KV cache and batching behavior more accurately.

Pre-call ask (short):
- Upload sample traces to the Drive folder I shared by Mon EOD PT
- Fill out the sizing-template.xlsx with your average/peak numbers
- Confirm whether you plan to use in-line retrieval (we'll need to know vector store QPS)

I'll drop a Zoom link and calendar invite in a follow-up. If there are any internal stakeholders (security, procurement) who should be looped in early, flag them now.

Thanks — see you Tue.

— Nikhil

Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — proposed slots & pre-call checklist

Hi Alex / Maria —

Thanks for confirming the slot. I've created the calendar event and Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (invite attached). Event: Tue 3/28 11:00–12:00 PT. Please accept when convenient.

Pre-call checklist (what we'll review in the first 10 minutes, so we can get straight to sizing):
- Confirm token histogram & sample traces (location: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIZING)
- Provide estimates for KV cache hit rate and average session length
- List of endpoints (chat vs embeddings vs rerank) and expected QPS per endpoint
- Any current throttles or upstream rate limits we should know about

Also attaching a brief internal-runbook template (sizing-template.xlsx) — feel free to populate inline. On the call we'll run a quick capacity projection and map to Dedicated pool configurations (GPU class, pool size, burst policy).

If you want, we can reserve an extra 30 minutes right after the session for an optional ops deep-dive — say 12:15–12:45 PT — useful if your infra team wants to discuss network / VPC setup. Let me know.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
